body.p: ; written first so packet can rely on it.

item.p: Assembly: src/function_library.c indexes whatever parts its configuration names (); no file lists another file's rows, and no shared list exists to edit. 1.21 only defines sxml_function_library_higher_order, _map and _array in its own files; the processor (1.23) names every part, unit tests name the parts they test (plus a test-only part of their own if they need one). sxml_function_table_find is defined in src/function_library.c.

fn:sort (every arity, with or without $key) is one resumable row in src/function_library_sequence.c (1.20); 1.21 writes array:sort only. fn:position and fn:last are rows of src/function_library_context.c.

Files (all under the module prefix): the six part files of , plus src/function_library_deep_equal.c (fn:deep-equal, a row of the sequence part), src/function_library_case.c (Unicode 16.0 full case mappings without conditions, generated by tools/generate-case-tables.py from UnicodeData.txt and SpecialCasing.txt) and src/function_library_core_internal.h (row macros, argument readers, heap text builder, collation check, position spans; defined in src/function_library.c). function_library_internal.h is unchanged.

Library: indexed rows sorted by interned name (binary search); types resolved on first find and kept; variadic rows get repeated-type arrays kept in a chain so entry views stay valid; signatures registered per find. xs: constructors for atomic, union and list types (not anyAtomicType, NOTATION).

4.0 semantics followed (from the QT4 tests): fn:max/min return the item itself, unpromoted, ordered by fn:compare (durations and QNames too), the first NaN wins when reached first; fn:subsequence and fn:substring take xs:numeric and add integers exactly (FOAR0002 past int64_t, PR2543); rounding of doubles uses the exact binary value; codepoints-to-string accepts XML 1.1 characters; string-length and normalize-space accept any item; fn:index-of matches NaN; fn:error's result type is xs:error; unknown string keys of deep-equal options are XPTY0004.

Resumable rows (): fn:sort (key calls) and fn:replace (function replacement, coerced by the body with sxml_evaluator_coerce because the evaluator does not apply function coercion inside a choice type, so the parameter is item()?).

Not supported yet: collations other than codepoint (FOCH0002); deep-equal options items-equal, ordered=false, unordered-elements, ignore-empty-entries, false-on-error, normalization-form and non-default schema-related options (UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE); deep-equal of two inline functions written alike is false; fn:trace does not print; the random-number-generator map is not annotated with the named record type.
